source:
# Port of lib/pubid/jcgm/parser.rb: JCGM base, meeting, amendment and
# corrigendum identifiers, and the named GUM/VIM guides.
#
# Edition-2 notes: the amendment/corrigendum base wrapper capture drops
# (a wrapper over rule refs expands to element hashes, and the bindings
# cannot nest); the base keeps the canonical number/date captures and the
# amendment layer captures under supp_number/supp_date, mirroring the
# iec supp_* position-scoped convention. The year_digits body is inlined
# at every capture site, and bare helper refs adjacent to captures stay
# raw literals (a parenthesized ref materializes a stray named node).

grammar PubidJcgm version "0.1.0" edition 2 {
  century = "19" / "20"
  year_digits = century 2*digit !digit
  digits = 1*digit
  publisher = "JCGM" as publisher
  ordinal_suffix = "st" / "nd" / "rd" / "th"
  gum_number = "GUM-" ( 1*digit ) as gum_number
  standard_number = ( 1*digit ) as number
  number_portion = gum_number / standard_number
  full_date = {
    ( ("19" / "20") 2*(%x30-39) !(%x30-39) "-" 2*(%x30-39) "-" 2*(%x30-39) ) as date
  }
  year_only = ( ("19" / "20") 2*(%x30-39) !(%x30-39) ) as date
  date_portion = ":" ( full_date / year_only )
  language_portion = "(" ( ( "E/F" / "F/E" ) / %x41-5A ) as languages ")"
  base = publisher " " number_portion [date_portion] [language_portion]
  meeting_identifier = {
    publisher " " ( 1*digit ) as number ("st" / "nd" / "rd" / "th") " " "Meeting" as type_with_stage
    [ ( " (" ( ("19" / "20") 2*(%x30-39) !(%x30-39) ) as date ")" ) ]
  }
  amendment_identifier = {
    base "/" "Amd" as type_with_stage ( " " / ("." [" "]) ) ( 1*digit ) as supp_number
    [ ( ":" ( ( ("19" / "20") 2*(%x30-39) !(%x30-39) "-" 2*(%x30-39) "-" 2*(%x30-39) ) as supp_date
            / ( ("19" / "20") 2*(%x30-39) !(%x30-39) ) as supp_date ) ) ]
  }
  corrigendum_identifier = {
    base " " "Corrigendum" as type_with_stage
  }
  numbered_corrigendum_identifier = {
    base "/" "Cor" as type_with_stage ( " " / ("." [" "]) ) ( 1*digit ) as supp_number
    [ ( ":" ( ( ("19" / "20") 2*(%x30-39) !(%x30-39) "-" 2*(%x30-39) "-" 2*(%x30-39) ) as supp_date
            / ( ("19" / "20") 2*(%x30-39) !(%x30-39) ) as supp_date ) ) ]
  }
  named_number = ( "GUM" / ( "VIM" [ "-" 1*digit ] ) ) as number
  named_guide_identifier = publisher " " named_number
  identifier = {
      meeting_identifier
    / amendment_identifier
    / corrigendum_identifier
    / numbered_corrigendum_identifier
    / base
    / named_guide_identifier
  }
  upper = %x41-5A
  digit = %x30-39
  slash = "/"
  dash = "-"
  colon = ":"
  space = " "
  entry identifier: identifier

  bindings identifier {
    publisher -> publisher (string)
    number -> number (string)
    gum_number -> gum_number (string)
    date -> date (string)
    supp_number -> supp_number (string)
    supp_date -> supp_date (string)
    languages -> languages (string)
    type_with_stage -> type_with_stage (string)
  }

  test {
    accept "JCGM 200:2008(F)"
    accept "JCGM 100:2008"
    accept "JCGM 1st Meeting (2004)"
    accept "JCGM 100:2008/Amd.1:2026"
    accept "JCGM 101:2008/Cor.1:2009"
    reject "nonsense"
  }
}
